notes:
Summary: enterprise support SaaS building a support-agent + ticket-deflection RAG. Tight latency SLOs (p95 <=150-200ms for top-k retrieval + rerank path) and strong cost sensitivity for high query volume. CTO quote: "We need top-5 answers that reduce escalations by 30% or we won't move forward."

POC specifics and shorthand:
- Target index: 50M archived tickets + KB articles + convo snippets (~TBs compressed).
- Embedding pipeline: 1536-d dense vectors, batch embed daily delta, real-time incremental for new tickets.
- Retrieval stack: HNSW index + sparse BM25 fallback; hybrid rerank on top-20 -> produce top-5.
- Reranker expectation: measurable lift over existing Lambda-based reranker (target +0.15 top-5 precision).
- Latency: end-to-end retrieval+rerank p95 target 150-200ms; acceptable fallback route to lower-cost model at 300-400ms during spikes.
- Cost target: below $0.003 per user query (incl. vector search + reranker amortized).

Security & compliance: must pass SOC2 Type II, SSO/SAML integration, EU data residency contract clause. Legal wants KMS control or BYOK for encryption-at-rest.

Internal stakeholders: CTO (decision lead), Head of Support Ops (champion), Legal + Security involved for residency/KMS.

Quoted concerns from Support Ops: "Latency matters more than micro improvements in accuracy if customers feel slow."

Open asks (for Redwood):
- Verified perf numbers on 50M index (p95 / throughput),
- Cost breakdown (embeds storage, search ops, rerank GPU ops),
- Canary/cookie-cutter configs for autoscale + cache warming,
- SLAs for fallback model behavior and rollbacks.
